intro: Yemen was the poorest country in the Arab world even before the war, which has wrecked its economy.

chapters.title: Before the war
text: Oil and gas exports, farming and money from Yemenis working in Saudi Arabia supported the economy.

chapters.title: Today
text: Coffee, honey and fish are prized exports. Many people depend on food aid, and the currency has collapsed.

keyTerms.meaning: Food given to people who cannot get enough.
